title: ViewerCommand
description: Request body for the engine's playback control: the engine is a DVR over the broadcast.

command.title: ViewerCommandType
command.description: `play`, `pause` and `set_speed` act on the viewer's own playback; `seek` moves it to a point in the match up to the live edge (a later point goes live); `go_live` catches up with the broadcast and follows it.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier while behind live. Required for set_speed.
